comments.body:
> I don't think I would mind getting worse grades at this point because what is the point of grades beyond BP anyways but I would prefer not to fail something.

They might be relevant depending on your masters or when applying for an internship.

I wouldn't force myself to do a side-project if you don't have anything you are passionate about. If you want to gain practical experience it's probably better to look for an internship or a small part-time job. Since this will teach you how to work on a project in a professional environment. There are companies in Zurich that are hiring students and know what they can expect of them.
comments.author: dumogin
